pages.text: Don't know how to craft something? Hover your mouse over the item and press $(bold)R$() - a list of every recipe that makes it pops up instantly.
Press $(bold)U$() instead to see everything that item is $(italic)used$() in - handy for figuring out what to do with something you just picked up.
You can also just open your inventory and search the item list on the right side - type a name and every matching item shows up.
